annotations.text: ON CE LOGIC PAGE MC501 THERE IS A DELAY CARD TO BE USED
WITH TABLE 1. THIS DELAY IS USED TO INSURE THAT ALL THE
SAB BITS REACH THE STORAGE ELEMENT (SE) OR DISPLAY
ELEMENT (DE) WITH THE SELECT PULSE. THE LATEST SAB
BITS ARE THE TAG BITS. SAB 01 THRU SAB 04.
TO SET UP THE COMPUTE ELEMENT (CE), THE ATR, CCR AND
PHYSICAL PSBAR MUST BE AS SHOWN IN TABLE 2.
TABLE 2: TO SET UP SELECTED CE
NOTE: ATR SLOT 1 IS SET UP IN TABLE 2 SO THE STORAGE
ADDRESS FOR PSBAR DOES NOT USE THE SAME TAG BIT AS IS
SCOPED FOR THE STORAGE TO BE TESTED. THIS IS WHY THE
STORAGE CALLED OUT IN ATR SLOT 1 IS NOT CONFIGURED
AND DOES NOT NEED TO BE AVAILABLE.
THE INSTRUCTIONS IN TABLE 3 MUST THEN BE KEYED
TABLE 3: PROGRAM TO BE ENTERED IN CE
PUT THE DEFEAT INTERLEAVING SWITCH IN THE PROC.
(CENTER) POSITION, AND INSURE THAT THE INTERVAL
TIMER SWITCH IS IN THE DISABLE POSITION.
PUT 085000 IN THE ADDRESS KEYS, DEPRESS THE SET IC
PUSHBUTTON, THEN DEPRESS THE START PUSHBUTTON WHILE
THE RATE SWITCH IS IN PROCESS.
YOU NOW HAVE A PROGRAM RUNNING IN THE CE WHICH WILL
SEND BOTH ODD AND EVEN SELECT PULSES TO THE DESIRED
STORAGE BOX AND WILL ALSO SEND ONE OR MORE OF THE
SLOWEST ADDRESS BITS TO THAT STORAGE BOX SO THAT BY
SCOPING IN THE STORAGE YOU MAY DETERMINE IF THE
SLOWEST ADDRESS BITS DO INDEED ARRIVE AT THE STORAGE
BEFORE OR COINCIDENT WITH BOTH THE ODD AND EVEN
USING A 453 SCOPE OR ITS EQUIVALENT, SYNC ON THE
SELECTED SAB BIT PER TABLE 4, IN THE APPROPRIATE
PLACE THE B PROBE ON FIRST 'SELECT EVEN' THEN 'SELECT
ODD' PER TABLE 5, FOR THE APPROPRIATE CE.
OBSERVE THE WAVEFORMS AT THE POINTS SPECIFIED IN
TABLES 4 AND 5. IF THE SELECTED SAB BIT DOES NOT LEAD
BOTH SELECT EVEN AND SELECT ODD BY AT LEAST 5 NSEC USING THE
INITIAL SELECT TIMING POINT FROM TABLE 1, ADD DELAY TO THE
SELECT TIMING PULSE USING THE DELAY CARD SHOWN IN FIGURE
TABLE 4: SELECTED SAB BIT SCOPING POINTS IN SE OR DE
SEE SE LOGIC BA011 THRU BA041 OR DE LOGIC BA001 AND BA011
TABLE 5: SE AND DE SCOPING POINTS
WHEN SELECTING THE DELAY TAP AS SHOWN IN FIGURE 2,
THAT WITH THE LEAST DELAY ALLOWS THE SELECTED SAB BIT TO
PRECEED SELECT EVEN AND SELECT ODD AS SHOWN IN FIGURE 1
PLEASE ENTER IN TABLE 1 THE PIN NUMBER OF THE DELAY USED.
